column5: PIPE / GARDEN / HDPE / MOULDING / PTMT / CP / TANK
Must match the tab name in the Google Sheet exactly (e.g. M/C-1)
Appears in the MACHINE column (merged cell). Format must be M/C-n or MACHINE-n so the daily-join key can match it.
Only for Moulding (or plants that track material per machine). Left blank = no mould/material breakdown.
Month labels the parser understands: APR'26 · MAY'26 · JUN'26 · JUL'26 etc. Also APR-26 or APR 26.
Total planned/available machine hours for the month (e.g. 30 days × 16 hrs = 480). Merged cell — only one entry per machine per sheet; the engine carries it forward across all months.
Actual run hours recorded that month.
KG for extrusion plants (Pipe/Garden/HDPE). PCS for Moulding. This is the GROSS output for monthly; for PIPE daily the engine reconciles net vs gross.
Ideal rate per hour (kg/hr or pcs/hr). Merged cell — one entry per machine. The engine computes ideal_output = actual_hours × this rate. Do NOT enter total ideal output here.
Rejection quantity. The engine recomputes rejection % = rejection ÷ output — the stored % cell in the sheet is ignored.
Runner/lumps weight for Moulding machines. Blank for all extrusion plants.
